tests.description: A thread starts empty and a subthread starts with a copy of its parent's history, three levels deep. Each block is checked by the questions it holds; the model's answers are checked only where it had history to work from (res1, res5, res6), since the answers in the empty threads are made up.
tests.expectedOutput: {"msgs": ["What is the first prime number > 100?"], "msgs2": ["What are the next 2 prime numbers after that?"], "msgs3": ["What are the next 2 prime numbers after that?", "What are the next 2 prime numbers after that?"], "msgs4": ["What are the next 2 prime numbers after that?"], "msgs5": ["What is the first prime number > 100?", "What are the next 2 prime numbers after that?"], "msgs6": ["What is the first prime number > 100?", "What are the next 2 prime numbers after that?", "What are the next 2 prime numbers after that?"], "msgs7": ["What are the next 2 prime numbers after that?"], "msgs3CopiesMsgs2": true, "msgs5CopiesMsgs": true, "msgs6CopiesMsgs5": true, "res1": [101], "res5": [103, 107], "res6": [109, 113]}
